content.short: Injective is a highly interoperable layer-1 blockchain in the Cosmos ecosystem.
content.description: Injective is a layer-1 blockchain network and smart contract platform designed for high interoperability with other networks. It includes a decentralized ERC-20 token bridge that makes native Ethereum-based assets usable within its ecosystem, enabling seamless cross-chain value transfer. The Injective Hub serves as the central gateway, bringing together core DeFi capabilities. By connecting to the Injective Hub, DeFi users can perform token swaps, earn staking rewards, and participate in governance proposals, shaping the network's development.
